comment: SHOPRi8 Firestore composite indexes. Mirrors the queries in src/lib/firebase/firestore.ts; Firestore requires a composite index for any query combining an equality filter with an orderBy on a different field.

indexes.comment: Retailer order queue: one shop, optionally one status, newest first.
Retailer order queue for a shop without a status filter.
Open delivery board: unassigned tasks, newest first.
A worker's own task history, newest first.
Customer shops by category, restricted to active shops.
Purchasable products for one active shop.

fieldOverrides.comment: shops.ownerId and users.capabilities are single-field queries, served by Firestore's automatic single-field indexes. Declaring them as composite indexes is rejected by the API.
Capability lookups use array-contains on users.capabilities, covered by the automatic index.
Catalogue image refs can be long shared asset paths or Storage download URLs. Excluded from indexing.
